scriptEn.hook: Three big moments from the World Cup right now.

stories.headline: Hosts USA open World Cup with a 4-1 win over Paraguay
stories.summary: The host United States opened its home World Cup in style, beating Paraguay four goals to one. Folarin Balogun scored twice and Giovanni Reyna added a stunning strike. The win gives the Americans a dream start and big momentum in front of their home crowd.

keyword.definitionEn: the feeling of moving forward with growing success

stories.commentQuestion: Can the USA go all the way on home soil?

stories.headline: Brazil held to a 1-1 draw by a stubborn Morocco
stories.summary: Five-time champion Brazil was held to a one-all draw by Morocco in an entertaining Group C match. Morocco, a 2022 semifinalist, showed again it can trouble anyone. The dropped points mean Brazil must now fight harder to win its group.

keyword.definitionEn: a game that ends with both teams on equal points

stories.commentQuestion: Is Brazil still the team to beat this World Cup?

stories.headline: Australia stun Türkiye 2-0 in the World Cup's first big shock
stories.summary: Australia produced the day's biggest surprise, beating Türkiye two-nil. The Socceroos defended hard and struck twice to stun a fancied opponent. It is a statement win that throws Group D wide open and lifts hopes back home.

keyword.definitionEn: a surprise win against a stronger opponent

stories.commentQuestion: Which underdog will shock the World Cup next?

todaysWord.definitionEn: a surprise win against a stronger opponent
todaysWord.definitionJp: 番狂わせ（格上に勝つこと）

scriptEn.close: That's your World Cup in sixty. Follow for more.

stories.headline: 開催国アメリカ、パラグアイに4-1で初戦白星
stories.summary: 開催国アメリカが本拠地でのW杯初戦をパラグアイに4-1で快勝。バログンが2得点、レイナも見事な一撃を決めた。地元の大観衆の前で理想的なスタートを切り、大きな勢いを得た。

stories.headline: ブラジル、モロッコと1-1ドロー
stories.summary: 優勝5回のブラジルが、グループCの好ゲームでモロッコと1-1の引き分け。2022年4強のモロッコは今回も強豪を苦しめた。勝ち点を落としたブラジルは、首位通過へ正念場を迎える。

stories.headline: オーストラリアがトルコを2-0、大会初の大金星
stories.summary: オーストラリアがこの日最大の驚きを演出し、トルコを2-0で破った。サッカルーズは堅守から2得点を奪い、優勝候補を撃破。グループDを混戦に持ち込み、母国の期待を高めた。
